description: This file defines the UnixSocketConnectionFactory class, which implements the IConnectionFactory interface to create and manage Unix domain socket connections within the Orleans testing host environment. It handles socket creation, connection establishment, and connection initialization with custom options and schedulers.

classes.name: UnixSocketConnectionFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating Unix domain socket connections, implementing connection setup and management for Orleans testing host.

methods.name: UnixSocketConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the factory with logging, options, schedulers, and memory pool.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously establishes a Unix domain socket connection to the specified endpoint and returns a connection context.
